description: This file defines data structures, templates, and macros related to network traffic annotation, including hash computation, annotation tags, partial annotations, and related utility functions. It is used for annotating and managing network traffic in Chromium-based projects.

classes.name: NetworkTrafficAnnotationTag
classes.description: Represents a network traffic annotation with a unique ID hash code, supporting comparison and special 'NotReached' state.

classes.name: PartialNetworkTrafficAnnotationTag
classes.description: Represents a partial network traffic annotation with hash codes for unique ID and optionally for the completing ID, used for incremental annotation definitions.

classes.name: MutableNetworkTrafficAnnotationTag
classes.description: A mutable version of NetworkTrafficAnnotationTag, allowing validation, reset, and conversion to immutable form.

classes.name: MutablePartialNetworkTrafficAnnotationTag
classes.description: A mutable version of PartialNetworkTrafficAnnotationTag, allowing validation, reset, and conversion to immutable form.

methods.name: recursive_hash
methods.description: Computes a compile-time hash code of a string using recursion.

methods.name: DefineNetworkTrafficAnnotation
methods.description: Defines a network traffic annotation tag from a unique ID and protobuf text, returning a NetworkTrafficAnnotationTag.

methods.name: DefinePartialNetworkTrafficAnnotation
methods.description: Defines a partial network traffic annotation for later completion.

methods.name: CompleteNetworkTrafficAnnotation
methods.description: Completes a partial annotation into a full annotation.

methods.name: BranchedCompleteNetworkTrafficAnnotation
methods.description: Completes a partial annotation into a branched annotation with a group ID.

methods.name: CreateMutableNetworkTrafficAnnotationTag
methods.description: Creates a mutable network traffic annotation tag from a hash code.
